subject.title: Android: Add message copy and text selection to chat screen

question: Should Android message long-press ship only Copy/Select Copy first, or should Share and Reply be part of the same feature and possibly adopted from the open fork PR?
rationale: Source inspection proves the gap remains, but the requested action set includes product-scope behavior and the linked implementation path is currently conflicting.

options.title: Copy and Select Copy first
options.body: Land a narrow Android message action menu for whole-message copy and selectable text, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up decisions.

options.title: Full action sheet
options.body: Accept Copy, Select Copy, Share, and Reply as one feature, but require a refreshed branch and explicit proof that Reply sends clear context.

options.title: Defer Android message actions
options.body: Leave the issue open as a lower-priority UX request if maintainers do not want to expand Android chat interactions now.

recommendation.title: Copy and Select Copy first
recommendation.body: Land a narrow Android message action menu for whole-message copy and selectable text, leaving Share and Reply for follow-up decisions.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has recent Android chat history plus committer involvement on adjacent Android markdown work.
